address: 24 Soi Sukhumvit 53, Khlong Tan Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Set in a traditional Thai house done out in dark wood, this cosy restaurant exudes rustic charm and sincerity. The menu is rooted in time-honoured recipes and mindful gastronomy, skilfully using rare regional produce sourced from small farmers to explore Thai culinary heritage. Precise techniques underpin deliberately simple presentations that let the depth and balance of the flavours shine. Mains arrive samrap style for sharing, fostering conviviality....
